whyAdmitted: Arrived in ICU 20 minutes following emergency rapid sequence intubation in ED for acute severe breathlessness unresponsive to continuous nebulisers.
whatHasBeenDone: Intubated in ED, switched from transport ventilator to ICU ventilator upon arrival.
currentSupport: Invasive mechanical ventilation on VC-AC (VT 480 mL, RR 18, PEEP 5 cmH2O, FiO2 0.60).
theWorry: High peak airway pressure alarm is sounding and the bedside nurse urgently reports that the blood pressure is acutely falling.
background: Severe persistent asthma since childhood with two prior ICU admissions. No regular inhaled corticosteroids for past 3 months. Presented to ED in extremis with silent chest and exhaustion.
